title: Lemon Chive Aoli (aioli)
preamble:
Although perfect for the grilled skewers, this multipurpose dip is also delicious with crunchy fresh vegetable sticks. Try with a raclette recipe.

1 cup (250 mL) light mayonnaise

2 tbsp (30 mL) finely chopped fresh chives or green onions

1 tbsp (15 mL) grated lemon rind

2 tsp (10 mL) lemon juice
ingredients: 2 tbsp (30 mL) finely chopped fresh chives or green onions
method: In bowl, stir together mayonnaise, chopped fresh chives, lemon rind and juice, grainy mustard, garlic, salt and pepper. (Make-ahead: Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 days.)
details: Category: Condiments, Jams, Preserves, Pickles and Sauces
